programme.desc: Glug Jug. Maddie accidentally breaks a piece of pottery that Mum made. Instead of doing the right thing and owning up to it, she starts to worry about how badly everything will go!

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Airport Worker. Dylan the airport worker wants to help travellers catch their flights. So when a suitcase rolls away, he needs to find it and bring it back before the plane takes off!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Who Is Sleepy Now? Kiri and Lou can't sleep. Pania says she will sing them a song, but only if they stay awake for the whole thing.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Top of the Pops. Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes help a young Cornasaurolophus reach the top of a volcano.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Shaun. Dad transforms his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Bridge Badge. It's bridge building time! The Squirrels help a quarreling group of Gerbils sort out their longstanding disagreement.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Snail. Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have a snail slime race. But who will win, Team King or Team Queen?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Miss Gerrard's Birthday. It's Miss Gerrard's birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Dylan the Dinosaur. Jen and Small are having a sleepover, but Small doesn't have a toothbrush that's her size.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Rabbanit. Ramie, who is a rabbanit, tells us all about her ram's horn shofar and why she loves to hear the sound it makes.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: No Dogs Allowed. Charli is meeting her friend Annabel for lunch at the local café. But Tinks needs all her big dog energy to help Charli persuade the owner to let them in.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Sleeping Bag and Mattress. Maddie goes camping to find out how sleeping bags work and uses a special camera to learn how mattresses are made up of layers of foam and material.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Lion. Preschool series about words. Dee encourages a friend to say 'lion', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure, seeing what lions look like and what they do.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Rolling Sixes. Join the Six Times Table in a game show to work out who the Rolling Sixes are. The start and end are easy, but can she figure out the friends in the middle?

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: In. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. I holds hands with N and they find themselves stuck inside a floating balloon.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Potted Plant Parade. Toad needs another potted plant for the flower show after he drops the first one - it needs eight flowers on it for the competition.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Choosing Colours. Red and Blue choose colours for their playhouses. Learn about making colour choices.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Radio Badge. The Squirrels find some of Duggee's radio equipment and decide to start their own show.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: The Beat in Your Feet. The garden gang compete in a three-legged race. Stripes struggles until he finds his three-legged rhythm.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Vehicles. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble goes on a surprise bus journey with his family, while Justin and his friends go on a boat adventure!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Roundy Round. Preschool series. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po do a roundy round dance and watch children in Tummy Tales ride a carousel which goes round and round too.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Vida's New Helpers. When Popcorn gets sick, Fergie and Kipp offer to help Vida out in the clinic. But their competitive natures get in the way of them working together.

programme.title: New: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: A Few Dinos Too Many! The Game Catchers find themselves on a Beachy Planet and learn to play the game pour and fill. They need to be creative when making more materials for the game!

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild
programme.desc: Harris's Hawk and Leafcutter Ant. Steve and Aneeshwar meet the incredible Harris's hawk and clever leafcutter ants.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle's Paint Disaster. Preschool comedy drama series. The Brooklyn-Bells decorate Doug's bedroom. Waffle causes a green paint disaster and escapes into Mrs Hobbs's house next door.

programme.title: Topsy and Tim
programme.desc: Wide Awake. Live-action children's show. It's the night before Topsy and Tim move house, and Kerry's parents arrive for a farewell dinner party with Mummy and Dad.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Jam Session Day. Bad Idea Puppy is at Love Monster's house to jam but gets locked in his bathroom. When Love Monster tries to get him out through the window, he gets locked in too!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Mystery of the Longfin Eels. Some baby longfin eels vanish, prompting the Octonauts to investigate the mystery.

programme.desc: When Dad Got the Hiccups. Dad gets a severe case of Proximan hiccups. Big Lizard and Cosima do their best to help, but their attempt to scare Dad goes wrong when a real 'monster' turns up!

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Family Meeting. When Dad's accused of 'fluffing' in Bluey's face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter.

programme.desc: Swim School. Pleasing Big Fish class instructor Margaret is proving difficult for Mum, Dad and Bingo.
